newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures were mixed in quiet early trade and September Standard and Poor's 500 futures traded on both sides of Friday's close.

Several traders said September could be in for a choppy day after posting a new record high Friday at 906.40 -- the first above 900.00. With no U.S. economic news on Monday's agenda, September was vulnerable to technical trading, they said.
Several traders said firm but quiet Treasury bonds would lend September S&Ps support.
One trader said any sign of strength Monday could quickly translate into a new high.
"This market is just unbelievable," the S&P 500 futures trader said. "I don't see any reason why we wouldn't test the contract high again today," he said.
Another trader said profit-taking after last week's stellar run above 900.00 could keep September's next leg up a bit tentative.
One firm pegged September fair value at 9.90 points premium to cash, buy programs at 11.90 points premium to cash or wider and sells at 10.00 premium to cash or narrower.
Good support was pegged at Friday's 895.20 day session low and at the Globex low of 893.50. Intraday support was seen at 900.00.
Traders said September could remain tethered near Friday's closing price as players wait on the sidelines for May consumer price data Tuesday.
A Reuters poll of economists showed an average estimate of up 0.2 percent in overall consumer prices and also excluding the volatile food and energy sectors.
In April, CPI rose 0.1 percent overall and 0.3 percent in the core rate.

"So far all I've seen is some selling from (a dealer) and some expiration-related selling," another S&P 500 futures trader said early in the session. He said the June/September spread had traded about 3,000 times in the first half hour.
"That accounts for about half of our volume," he said.

At 0925 CDT/1425 GMT, Sept S&Ps were up 1.15 pts to 904.50, Value Line were flat at 794.80, Nikkei gained 100.00 to 20,835.00, Midcap lost 1.20 to 291.00, NYSE Composite rose 0.15 to 470.30, Russell fell 2.00 to 396.00, and Nasdaq rose 3.50 to 981.50.
